Toy samples, one per contracted table. Values are made up (data_version `toy` on A's tables,
`data-v0-toy` on B's, whose contracts require the `data-v<N>` form); they exist so both sides
can build against the contract before the real data exists and must never be used in an
analysis. District ids are real Census 2011 codes (588 Kasaragod, 594 Thrissur, 595 Ernakulam,
598 Alappuzha, 599 Pathanamthitta, 381 Cuttack, 386 Khordha, 387 Puri), and event and scenario
ids in the C5 samples are the ones in the C4 samples. Geometry is WKT boxes, not real
boundaries.
